summary: A voice request never ends silently: beyond the 30 s voice budget the brain turn says a short notice and, when the app opts in (warmReady.deferredReadback, voiceTurn.deferredReadback), the voice turn protocol follows the same run and reads its answer once in the same session through speakDeferred; newer requests, stop, session close and staleness cancel it. Root cause of the S24 30/10 incident: the app drops a retired brain turn before both its notice and its A1 readback.

routes.change: optional voiceTurn.deferredReadback opt-in; pending brain notice text changed
routes.budget: unchanged 30 s voice budget; deferred follow: one run-registry read per second per open deferred turn (max 3 per session), at most 5 min, no Gateway call per read for an observed run

routes.change: new v2 control and events: exactly-once deferred notice and answer of a brain turn
routes.budget: no storage; readback bounded to 600 characters; existing 64-turn and 512-operation limits

evidence: scripts/test-voice-deferred-readback.cjs (16 cases, new, registered in .github/workflows/ci.yml job mobile-ui-plugin)
scripts/test-voice-brain-delegation.cjs and scripts/test-warm-v2-ownership.cjs updated, already registered

fixtures.provenance: S24 Companion stderr and Gateway run of the 30/10 22:21 incident, sanitized (session key shortened, bill amounts fictitious)

capability_impact.detail: No capability added or changed. A readback executes nothing; payment and deterministic routes are unchanged.

architecture_impact.reason: Same owners: the existing bounded read of the run continues for the voice turn protocol (Warm owner); the A1 readback turn shape is reused. No new store, router, scheduler, queue or retry.

app_impact.detail: The incident shape (brain turn retired before its receipt) needs the paired APK: opt in per turn, keep a retired pending brain turn in the A1 list, send speakDeferred on admissibility and deferredReady, mirror the shared contract. Without it the deployed app keeps its current A1 behaviour with the new notice phrase.

mcp_parity.detail: No MCP tool or adapter change.

rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the Companion with companion-deploy.sh; an opted-in app no longer sees warmReady.deferredReadback and falls back to A1.
